name: v77_news_vwap_social_fast_confirm
hypothesis: Replace daily VWAP in the v76 successful template with zero-user event-session VWAP-from-news; keep only a small fast-earnings confirmation sleeve.
expression: 0.28 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.22 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vec_avg(main_session_vwap_from_news)) / close, 20)) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.08 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(main_session_thirty_minute_change_pct), 60), industry)
notes: Strict corr gate vs JjpPv3N2; mechanism changes the VWAP leg to news-time session absorption.

name: v77_news_to_close_absorption_social
hypothesis: Use the close relative to news-to-close VWAP plus first-30-minute reversal to capture overreaction/absorption after news without the fast-earnings sleeve.
expression: 0.30 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((vec_avg(session_closing_price_4_1555) - vec_avg(vwap_from_news_to_close_2_1555)) / close, 20)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(main_session_thirty_minute_change_pct), 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: No news18 bee; tests whether event-session absorption alone can strengthen the low-corr social seed.

name: v77_session_volume_absorption
hypothesis: Low event-day range/volume stress plus close-below-VWAP absorption may identify calmer reversals than the prior daily VWAP route.
expression: 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vec_avg(main_session_vwap_from_news)) / close, 20)) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(price_range_standard_deviation_2), 90), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(main_session_volume_stddev), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_60_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Tests event-session calm/absorption rather than fast earnings or reported FCF.

name: v77_post_news_underreaction_fast_small
hypothesis: Positive social/earnings context with weak immediate post-news price reaction can capture underreaction while staying less FCF/news-parent heavy.
expression: 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(main_session_ninety_minute_change_pct), 60), industry) + 0.20 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vec_avg(vwap_from_news_to_close_2_1555)) / close, 20)) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Small fast-earnings context but event reaction is the largest differentiator; expected corr risk vs JjpPv3N2 must be checked.

name: v77_pre_to_post_session_absorption
hypothesis: Pre-market/news-session VWAP gap and social relief may capture overnight/pre-market overreaction rather than main-session daily reversal.
expression: 0.28 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((vec_avg(vwap_pre_session_1555) - vec_avg(vwap_from_news_to_close_2_1555)) / close, 20)) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(pct_change_thirty_minute_post_news_1555), 60), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.13 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Uses pre-session and post-news zero-user fields; avoids reported FCF and ordinary options.
